title: Character Knowledge, Experience & Explicit Familiarity Records
objective: Define explicit, visibility-safe Character knowledge, experience evidence and familiarity records over stable KFR-01/KFR-02 and canonical owner references while preserving Character, Progression/Skill and Permission authority and avoiding inferred knowledge, transfer mechanics or duplicate durable ownership.

resolved_contract.record_identity: Each input record has a stable record ID, Character reference, KFR subject reference, canonical owner reference/version, record version, provenance reference and visibility reference.
resolved_contract.state_rule: Explicit unknown is a positive explicit-unknown record. Absence of a record remains absence and is never rewritten or counted as explicit unknown.
resolved_contract.graph_rule: KFR-02 graph position, ancestry and adjacency may be referenced for explanation only; topology cannot create a record or invent knowledge/familiarity.
resolved_contract.authority_rule: Knowledge, experience and familiarity evidence remain distinct from proficiency, certification, permission, ownership, progression state and action authority; canonical owners remain authoritative and KFR-03 performs no canonical mutation.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized records are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.transfer_boundary: No transfer percentages, confidence degradation/propagation, incompatibility weighting or competence inheritance; those remain KFR-04. Operator qualification remains KFR-05.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-03 persistence. KFR-03 defines deterministic record/projection contracts over owner-referenced inputs and does not establish a duplicate Character knowledge ledger. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Record kind, subject/Character references, explicit-unknown state, provenance and authority explanations require accessible nonvisual equivalents.
resolved_contract.validation: Exactly one current KFR-03 Validation Core profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine RED before production, self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparator on one exact final head.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 and KFR-02 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical Character identity/state, Progression/Skill, domain-owner and Permission/visibility state remain authoritative.
KFR-03 introduces no duplicate durable Character knowledge ledger, canonical mutation, transfer/confidence mechanics, operator qualification or migration 0022.
KFR-04+, ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

retry_basis.evidence: Owner Continue after KFR-02 completed_verified; live app main c324ae8b82faf8815a35013e3a245a0c4ba6b29b and AIOC main 20119e5fd7adbc29a97c25408316b6db9f5bda0b were re-read. KFR-01 vocabulary and KFR-02 graph contracts establish reference-only, visibility-filtered semantics and do not establish KFR as a replacement Character knowledge owner.
changed_since_previous: Selection-only KFR-03 promoted to bounded in_progress authority on integration/kfr-03-character-knowledge-experience-explicit-familiarity-records.
Resolved explicit record kinds, absent-vs-explicit-unknown semantics, owner/provenance/version references, visibility filtering and no-persistence/no-migration decision before product mutation.
